These cookies help us analyze site usage and are NOT used for advertising. You can choose to enable or disable Google Analytics cookies below, and you may adjust your cookie preferences at any time. Performance Cookies These cookies allow us to count visits and traffic sources so we can measure and improve the performance of our site. They help us to know which pages are the most and least popular and see how visitors move around the site. If you do not allow these cookies, we will not know when you have visited our site, and will not be able to monitor its performance. We use cookies to improve your experience on our site and to understand where our audience is coming from. To find out more, please read our Privacy Policy . Innovating Construction with Technology Modern equipment for modern crews—built to close the labor gap, boost productivity, improve safety, and keep infrastructure projects on track. TyBOT IronBOT Development Solving Real-World Construction Challenges with Technology Advanced Construction Robotics (ACR) is transforming infrastructure with intelligent, robotic construction equipment designed to solve the industry's most pressing challenges. By filling the skilled labor gap and boosting productivity, our innovative solutions help crews work safer, faster, and more consistently—project after project. From concept to commercialization, our technology empowers contractors to meet growing demand while minimizing schedule risk and maximizing ROI. ACR brings robotic rebar tying, rebar placement, material handling, real-time monitoring, and new automation capabilities directly to the jobsite. A Smarter Way Forward for Construction From contractors and owners to DOTs and engineers, industry leaders are turning to technology that delivers measurable results—on and off the jobsite. ACR is building a future where automation and analytics power every phase of construction. General Contractors Reduce Risk, Deliver Faster, and Boost ROI. Our robotic solutions help general contractors increase productivity, improve safety, and maintain control over schedule and costs—without having to scale up labor. By automating repetitive, injury-prone tasks, our technology minimizes risk exposure, reduces workers’ comp claims and insurance costs, and helps you protect both your crews and your bottom line. Schedule Savings Specialty Subcontractors Strengthen Crew Capacity Without Increasing Headcount. Our robotic solutions help subcontractors keep pace with growing project backlogs—without overextending limited crews. By automating labor-intensive tasks, our technology reduces physical strain, supports consistent output, and improves task quality. This not only increases capacity and helps retain skilled workers by minimizing burnout and creating safer, more sustainable jobsite conditions. Schedule Savings Asset Owners Build Resilient Infrastructure, More Reliably. Our technology empowers contractors to meet compliance, safety, and delivery requirements with consistency. Automated processes reduce variability, enhance inspection readiness, and help future-proof infrastructure delivery in a constrained labor market. Contact Us to Learn More Strategic Partners Scaling the Future of Construction. We sit at the intersection of robotics, infrastructure, and AI. With a proven track record and growing market adoption, our solutions offer scalable impact, measurable ROI, and a first-mover advantage in one of the world’s most transformation-ready industries. Turning Vision into Action While we’re building for the future of construction, we’ve already delivered disruptive solutions that are transforming jobsites today. Our solutions are designed to automate the toughest, most repetitive tasks—unlocking productivity, reducing risk, and helping crews work smarter. Modern Equipment for Modern Crews Our intelligent, field-proven robots are just the beginning of ACR’s expanding solution offerings—each one purpose-built to support modern infrastructure demands with consistency, precision, and real-time performance insights. Watch Us In Action TyBOT With no pre-mapping or programming required, TyBOT self-locates, self-positions, and self-ties 1,200+ rebar intersections per hour. Learn More Watch Us In Action IronBOT IronBOT is designed for lifting, carrying, singulating, and self-placing bundles of both transverse and longitudinal rebar. Learn More Watch Us In Action Data That Drives Smarter Decisions Intelligence You Can Build On ACR’s robots don’t just automate—they generate actionable data that empowers project teams to plan better, work smarter, and deliver with confidence. Every robotic solution collects and reports telemetric insights that offer real-time visibility into performance, production, and equipment health—helping every stakeholder across the construction ecosystem make informed decisions. Monitor Monitor productivity in real-time and benchmark across projects. Gain insight into performance, reduce delays, and manage labor more efficiently. Track Track productivity rates and equipment utilization to optimize crew deployment and schedules. Use real-time data to improve job costing accuracy and refine future estimates with historical performance insights. Transparency Gain transparency into project execution with automated reporting. Use consistent data to support inspections, ensure compliance, and improve contractor accountability. Operational Metrics Access operational metrics that demonstrate usage, ROI, and adoption trends. Data-backed insights support scalability, reduce risk, and demonstrate how our solutions deliver measurable impact across the industry. TyBOT® and IronBOT® Earn Spot on Construction Digital's Top 10 Construction Robotics List As construction automation continues to reshape the industry, TyBOT® and IronBOT® have been recognized by Construction Digital as two of the leading robotic solutions driving that transformation. Featured in the publication's 2026 Top 10 Construction Robotics ranking, the robots were highlighted for improving productivity, enhancing worker safety, and helping bridge the skilled labor gap on infrastructure projects. Read More News Awards Read Time: 5 min Advanced Construction Robotics (ACR), the leader in construction robotics innovation, is proud to announce it will deliver one of two TyBOT® units to D.T. Read Steel Co., Inc. (D.T. Read) in early December. TyBOT is deployed on the I-26/I-95 Interchange Improvement Project in Harleyville, South Carolina, supporting D.T. Read’s ongoing efforts to enhance productivity, safety, and efficiency on high-volume rebar installation projects. D.T. Read’s second TyBOT will be delivered by the end of 2025. D.T. Read’s investment follows extensive hands-on experience using TyBOT across several major infrastructure projects, including the NASA Causeway Bridge Replacement in Titusville, Florida. On that project, TyBOT completed 139,261 ties, performing 50% of both the top and bottom mats on a significant portion of the 171,733-square-foot deck. Additionally, the jobsite required debris-free work areas, making cleanliness a top priority. TyBOT helped D.T. Read meet these requirements by significantly reducing tie-wire waste, eliminating the need for extensive cleanup. As a result, the company saved 1-2 full days that would have otherwise been spent clearing debris from traditional rebar tying methods. By expanding their use of TyBOT, D.T. Read continues its legacy of partnering with ACR, bringing innovation to the field and elevating expectations for performance in the rebar installation industry. “D.T. Read has consistently demonstrated strong leadership in adopting technologies that improve performance on the jobsite,” said Stephen Muck, Founder & CEO of Advanced Construction Robotics. “Their experience with TyBOT has shown the real-world value of automation, and we’re excited to continue supporting their team as they integrate robotics to boost productivity, enhance safety, and strengthen their competitive profitability edge.” By adding TyBOT to its operations, D.T. Read continues to advance its longstanding commitment to innovation and operational excellence. Their adoption of robotic solutions represents a growing industry movement toward integrating automation as a standard tool for delivering safer, faster, and higher-quality results. “Our team has seen how TyBOT can transform the way we work—improving speed, consistency, and safety on demanding projects,” said Chris Lewis, Vice President of D.T. Read Steel Co., Inc. “Adding these units allows us to expand our capacity and give our crews another tool of the trade that helps them perform their best. We are eagerly anticipating the release of ACR’s next commercial robot, IronBOT®, and we are confident it will further enhance our productivity and streamline our operations.” As more contractors recognize the value of robotics, ACR remains committed to advancing construction automation with jobsite-ready technology that strengthens project delivery across the nation. Advanced Construction Robotics Delivers D.T. Read Steel Co., Inc.’s TyBOT® Units to Support Their Southeast Infrastructure Work Advanced Construction Robotics (ACR), the leader in construction robotics innovation, is proud to announce it will deliver one of two TyBOT® units to D.T. Read Steel Co., Inc. (D.T. Read) in early December. TyBOT is deployed on the I-26/I-95 Interchange Improvement Project in Harleyville, South Carolina, supporting D.T. Read’s ongoing efforts to enhance productivity, safety, and efficiency on high-volume rebar installation projects. D.T. Read’s second TyBOT will be delivered by the end of 2025. Read More News TyBOT Read Time: 5 min TyBOT, the rebar-tying robot, has been used extensively on large installations such as bridge decks. Advanced Construction Robotics has announced that it is now offering its rebar-tying robot through direct sales in addition to ongoing service arrangements. Training on operating the rebar-tying robot is included in the sale price, as well as future software updates and access to an online portal to track its usage and productivity. Other options include other modes of travel for non-bridge projects and a new carry function for transporting materials around the jobsite. Read more by Jeff Rubenstone on Engineering News-Record : https://www.enr.com/articles/59256-rebar-tying-robot-now-available-for-direct-purchase-as-robotics-firm-sees-industry-acceptance Rebar-Tying Robot Now Available For Direct Purchase As Robotics Firm Gains Industry Acceptance Advanced Construction Robotics has announced that it is now offering its rebar-tying robot through direct sales in addition to ongoing service arrangements. Training on operating the rebar-tying robot is included in the sale price, as well as future software updates and access to an online portal to track its usage and productivity. Other options include other modes of travel for non-bridge projects and a new carry function for transporting materials around the jobsite.
